metadata.name: Geochemical Sediment Analysis from German Collector Trial Pre-Impact (SO268/1_43-1)
metadata.description: Geochemical sediment analysis data from a vertical core profile collected at station SO268_043MUC in the German collector trial pre-impact area. The dataset contains 106 columns representing elemental concentrations (Al, Ba, Ca2+, Cr, Cu, Fe, K, La, Li, Mg, Mn, Na, Ni, P, Sr, Ti) with associated relative and absolute error metrics, organized into primary measurements and two derived sets (_2 and _3). Data was collected on 2019-03-10 at a single location in the Pacific Ocean (11.93°N, 117.02°W) at a depth of approximately 4088 meters, with samples taken at 7 different sediment depths ranging from 0.0625 to 0.225.
